observations: Photo 0 is a single small photo of an inline four cylinder petrol car engine sitting loose on a wooden floor in a shop or store.
The valve cover is silver with red 'VVT-i' lettering, smaller text above it, and a Toyota emblem in the middle.
Intake manifold, alternator and pulleys are fitted; a gear or belt cover and wiring are partly present.
The block, head and manifold are grimy with dust and dried oil residue; one hose hangs loose.
No engine code, displacement figure or VIN is readable; the photo is too small to read the stamped code on the block.
A dealer watermark reading 'NWAKONOBI EZE' and a 'CAMON 40' camera stamp are on the photo.
Nothing shows the engine running or its mileage.

identity.kind: foreign-used Toyota four cylinder VVT-i petrol engine, engine code unknown
read_from: photo 0 Toyota emblem and VVT-i lettering on the valve cover

claims.evidence: The seller's own words also say 'direct from Belgium'; the two origins contradict each other, and nothing in photo 0 shows origin.
Conflicts with the seller's 'Direct America'; no import papers shown.
Photo 0 shows dust, grime and dried oil residue over the block, head and manifold.
No running video or test result; the engine sits loose on the floor in photo 0.
Needs a running video with sound.
No odometer screenshot from the donor car or record shown.
Photo 0 is too small to check gasket lines or factory sealant.
A promise, not something a photo can show; would need written terms from the dealer.

risks.risk: The exact engine code and size are unknown; Toyota used this style of VVT-i cover on several four cylinder engines of different size and value
risks.proof: Close photo of the stamped engine code on the block, with a handwritten note bearing today's date
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; no worst case without the engine code

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, burns oil or has low compression
risks.proof: Video of the engine running with sound, and a compression reading on all four cylinders
risks.if_unproven: as not working, for rebuild or parts

risks.risk: Engine has been opened or rebuilt despite 'never opened'
risks.proof: Close photos of the head gasket line and timing cover showing factory sealant

risks.risk: Cracked block or damaged mounts hidden under the grime
risks.proof: Clear photos of all four sides and the underside of the engine

risks.risk: Missing sensors, coils, injectors or wiring loom
risks.proof: Photo of the top with the coil cover off and of the wiring harness

proof_requests: Close photo of the stamped engine code on the block, with a handwritten note bearing today's date
Video of the engine running with sound
Clear full resolution photos of all four sides of the engine
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Toyota four cylinder VVT-i engine, but the engine code that sets the price is not readable and the seller's origin claims contradict each other. A worst case price needs the stamped engine code first.
